component.title: DrawerShell
component.purpose: Provide an accessible overlay that names its purpose, exposes a close action, and keeps its dialog content distinct from the underlying workspace.

priorities.statement: An open drawer communicates its title and dialog boundary before its body content.
People can identify a close action without relying on an icon alone.
Keyboard containment is a deliberate accessibility promise, not inferred from a screenshot.

states.description: Full-width drawer with a named dialog and close control.
Compact modal drawer with a named dialog.
Open drawer with an additional header action.

elements.description: The action that closes the drawer.
An optional action supplied in the drawer header.

claims.statement: The full drawer example renders a dialog for its content.
The compact drawer example renders a dialog for its content.
The header-actions example renders its supplied header action.
Keyboard focus remains contained in an open drawer until it is closed.
